correctness.rationale: Verified the design Gram G=2^d I_{d+1}-11^T has inverse M^{-1}(I+11^T/(M-d-1)), so the pinned symmetric hat kernel is exact. Used the signed full-cube Walsh row, parity zero-shell and Hamming orbit expressions to rederive the absolute row sums. For even d the row gap factorization has strict endpoint maximizers k=1,d except d=2, where the projection is the 3-by-3 identity; for odd d bound zero-shell |sum_{i in S}z_i| by min(k,d+1-k), also sharp only at endpoints. Row signs attain norm; row sum one implies negative coefficient mass=(norm-1)/2. Stirling gives √(2/π)d^{3/2}2^{-d} deletion gap. Independently enumerated 86,367 exact rational Gram-kernel entries over d=2..8 plus orbit maxima, confirming the algebra, not substituting for the infinite-dimensional binomial inequalities.
